GraphRAG Pipeline: Builder + EntityRefiner + TestRAG share Neo4j store and BAAI/bge-m3 embedding
PostgreSQL schema defined consistently across ORM models, SQL schema, and Alembic migrations
NIMOpenAI rate limit handling: APIKeyRotator + dynamic backoff form a unified retry/rotation pattern
